posts.title: What people said about an OpenZFS bug
posts.description: A few days ago I wrote about a OpenZFS bug I found and why it went unnoticed . It generated a surprising amount of chatter (at least for me!) which I found quite interesting, and did actually help clarify my thinking on a few things.
